description: NaNb₄Tl₃P₂O₁₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Ama2 space group. Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.53 Å. There are three inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with five NbO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-44°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-2.23 Å. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NbO₆ octahedra and corners with two PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-37°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.06 Å. In the third Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with four NbO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-39°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.19 Å. There are three inequivalent Tl sites. In the first Tl site, Tl is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (2.82 Å) and one longer (2.87 Å) Tl-O bond length. In the second Tl site, Tl is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one O atom. The Tl-O bond length is 2.72 Å. In the third Tl site, Tl is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (2.74 Å) and two longer (2.78 Å) Tl-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-53°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.59 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-41°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.57 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Nb and two Tl atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Tl, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two Nb and one Tl atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two Nb atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Nb and one Tl atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Nb and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Nb atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two Nb atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Nb and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Nb and one P atom.
